E2_NOT_APPLICABLE_example_trigger: KITTI-V2 or SportsMOT dataset mean reuse >= 0.5; no new rule for otherwise undefined separation
gate_absence_counting_scope: FINAL_OUTPUT_REJECTION: EVIDENCE + PRIOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED, for both false-absence and correct-empty gates
selection: E2 only if E1 fails and E2 passes

amendments.fit: Exact unclipped marginal log posterior with 20-point Gauss-Hermite and log-sum-exp
amendments.decision: Per-track LLR clipped to [-2,2] at each quadrature node, then summed over tracks, then integrated
amendments.unclipped_decision: Diagnostic only: count sentence-level absence disagreements per direction
amendments.reason: Laplace standard deviation needs a smooth fitting objective; clipping guards against overly optimistic DS at the decision layer, not the parameter-estimation layer

amendments.gate_scope: Both false-absence and correct-empty thresholds use final-output rejection (EVIDENCE + PRIOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED)
amendments.fixed_inputs: Use the original v8 questions and budgets; no resampling or extra questions
amendments.budget_exhausted_set: Recompute under each estimator: at video end p<0.1 without complete required-stratum evidence coverage
amendments.diagnostics: Report evidence-only counts, PRIOR_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED count and its GT-present subset separately; flag reliance on prior-based rejection
amendments.reason: Use the same output scope for both gates, matching v8 correct-empty baselines 347/330; a counterfactual estimator changes the video-end low-probability set despite fixed questions and budgets
